title: Nemotron 3 Super 120B-A12B (nemotron_h_moe): attention, reduced hybrid forward, sparse quantized expert streaming
author: LLM Bridge
scope: Component- and reduced-stack-level execution with independent numerical validation, plus one real packed-expert read from the G: shards. This is NOT a full 120B inference run (see full_model_inference_status).

commits_this_round.summary: feat(attn): Nemotron NoPE GQA attention sub-layer with KV cache
feat(hybrid): reduced Nemotron hybrid decoder forward pass
feat(moe): sparse quantized expert streaming via bounded authenticated reads

model_metadata_verified_from_shard1_head.attention_head_count_kv: per-layer array: 0 on recurrent layers, 2 on the 8 attention layers (indices 7,16,25,36,47,58,69,78); GQA 16:1
model_metadata_verified_from_shard1_head.positional_encoding: NoPE — the pinned build_attention_layer applies no RoPE and no Q/K norm for this arch (rope.* keys present but unused by the graph)
model_metadata_verified_from_shard1_head.sliding_window: none (swa_type == NONE asserted); no attention sinks
model_metadata_verified_from_shard1_head.layer_typing: recurrent iff head_kv==0 && feed_forward_length==0; attention iff head_kv!=0 (ff==0); MoE-FFN iff feed_forward_length==2688

attention.math: NoPE causal GQA: scores = (1/sqrt(head_dim)) * Q.K over cached keys [0..=t], stable softmax, weighted V, output projection wo (+ optional wo_b); fixed-capacity KV cache, O(n_kv) score buffer per query (no full context x context matrix)

independent_validation.oracle: from-scratch f64 attention oracle in the test module (no production calls)
independent_validation.kv_cache_match: < 1e-3 vs oracle for all cached positions
independent_validation.prefill_equals_incremental_decode: max_abs < 1e-5; KV cache (k and v) identical
cases: causal masking (future tokens do not change past outputs)

reduced_hybrid_forward.composition: embedding -> per layer { rms_norm(attn_norm) -> sub-layer (Mamba | attention | MoE-FFN) -> residual } -> rms_norm(output_norm) -> output projection -> logits; ordering/typing match the pinned graph
reduced_hybrid_forward.reduced_stack: [recurrent, attention, moe] with small faithful dims (n_embd 8, vocab 12); sub-layers reused unchanged
reduced_hybrid_forward.state: per-layer Mamba conv+SSM state and attention KV cache, session-local, with reset

independent_validation.oracle: from-scratch f64 oracle re-deriving embedding, RMS norms, all three sub-layers, residuals, and output projection

reduced_hybrid_forward.note: reduced-size only; no full-model numerical parity is claimed

sparse_quantized_expert_streaming.packed_layout: one GGUF tensor per projection holds all experts: ffn_up_exps [moe_n_embd, n_ff_exp, n_expert], ffn_down_exps [n_ff_exp, moe_n_embd, n_expert]; expert e is a contiguous sub-block at stride byte_len/n_expert
sparse_quantized_expert_streaming.mechanism: PackedExperts.expert_region(e) builds a rank-2 TensorRegion over expert e's own byte range; dequant_matvec reads it bounded and authenticated (range clamped to that expert), so no neighbouring expert's bytes are read; only selected experts are evaluated (sparse)

synthetic_validation.reference: dequantize_rows + f64 dot over the same sub-slice (separate FFI path)
cases: single-file stream_moe_experts of only selected experts
bad index / truncated source / cancellation / tiny workspace budget / bad packed geometry all rejected

real_model_validation.note: one expert's bytes only — not the whole tensor, not the model
real_model_validation.result: PASS — SplitGgufIndex resolution, PackedExperts sub-slice offsets, and dequant_matvec decode of real IQ2_XXS expert bytes all correct on the actual shards

memory_cpu_source_io.new_pure_modules: attention/hybrid are pure f32 arithmetic on small in-memory fixtures; no disk I/O
memory_cpu_source_io.sparse_expert_reads: bounded: per-expert range read only; the real-model test read 709632 bytes for one expert and nothing else from G:
memory_cpu_source_io.attention_kv_cache: fixed capacity * n_head_kv * head_dim f32; bounded, no full score matrix
memory_cpu_source_io.host_ram: ~13.8 GB total, ~2 GB free; model ~49 GB (not loaded)

regression.note: two chain tests use realistic small quantized magnitudes (scale 0.125, int8 in [-3,3]) so squared-ReLU stays well-conditioned in f32; tolerances were not loosened to hide a defect (single-tensor projections match to 1e-3 and the real-model read to 1.7e-9)
